title: Preparation method of bio-based non-isocyanate hybrid polyurethane
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of bio-based non-isocyanate hybrid polyurethane, and belongs to the technical field of polyurethane. First, diglycerol biscyclocarbonate is synthesized from diglycerol and dimethyl carbonate in the presence of a catalyst, the diglycerol biscyclocarbonate is mixed with aliphatic bisepoxy and petroleum based or bio-polyamines for reaction under conditions of no catalyst and solvent for preparation of the bio-based non-isocyanate hybrid polyurethane. The method is based on recyclable regenerative the diglycerol, epoxy and polyamines, and has the advantages of easy-to-get raw materials, mild reaction conditions, simple operation and environmentally-friendly process, and the bio-based non-isocyanate hybrid polyurethane prepared by the method has excellent mechanical properties.
